At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 For us, maps aren't just background graphics—they’re the core of the driver’s experience. While generic navigation apps focus on the everyday commute, Lyft Mapping is custom-built for the high-stakes, split-second realities of the rideshare experience. Drivers choose Lyft Maps because we solve the unique, complex challenges of living on the road: delivering glanceable turn guidance at speed, navigating tricky pick-up & drop-off dynamics, and providing real-time, AI-powered route assistance when every second counts. We build technology that empowers our drivers, transforms uncertainty into seamless flow, and sets the standard for real-time mobile navigation.
 We obsess over questions like: did your pickup spot feel safe and convenient? Did your driver feel confident following the route and arriving on the correct side of the road? Did you get stuck in unexpected traffic or road closures? You will tackle all of these challenges and more, with end to end ownership over the full ride experience, including driver navigation and rider pickup experiences. 
 We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to advocate and maintain a user-obsessed culture within Lyft, and be happy and comfortable in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. You'll partner with designers, researchers, marketers, and product managers to define and create top-notch experiences with safety as a core tenet for success. You’re experienced with every step of product development, from brainstorming broad ideas to ensure design quality through launch. Using your full range of interaction, visual, and product thinking skills, you will lead and own core Mapping experiences across our product teams.
 Responsibilities: 
 Own core experiences end to end. Lead design for Mapping's most important user-facing surfaces, from problem definition through launch and iteration. Your primary areas, in order of focus:
 Core Navigation – turn-by-turn guidance, map zoom and motion details, and how drivers orient themselves with the road
 Real-time Feedback and Voice AI – how drivers report what's happening on the road, including emerging voice and AI-assisted experiences
 Map styling and 3D views – the visual language of the map itself, including 3D and map assets
 Map Tooling – internal tools that help Lyft's mapping and operations teams keep the map accurate
 Drive cross-organizational alignment. Proactively reach across organizational boundaries to partner with cross-functional leaders, synthesize competing feedback, and build consensus around complex design decisions.
 Work at the systems level. Build reusable design-system components, tooling, and map assets that improve the platform as well as individual features, so every surface built on the map gets better.

 Support accurate implementation. Partner closely with engineering and content design through build, edge cases, and launch, so what ships matches what was designed.
 Lead through ambiguity. Take complex, loosely defined problems, work with product and engineering leads to frame them, and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities.

 Strong advocate and experimental mindset with AI-native prototyping and tooling, whether code-based, AI-assisted, or both
 Upholds Design+ quality: Confidently interprets and applies UX Standards (Accessibility, Safety, Reliability, Usability, and Lyft Product Language) to work
 A proactive mindset driving cross-team collaboration, self-directed in ambiguity, and receptive to giving and receiving feedback across all levels

Job description 
 This position plays an integral role in providing security and safety to all individuals accessing the hospital (staff, patients, clients and visitors).  As a multicultural facility, the individuals is maintained.  This is a hands-on position requiring people to be able to:  handcuff, restrain combative patients, and defuse violent or aggressive situations when they arise.
 Duties include but not limited to:
 Provide general security to the entire facility, including locking and unlocking doors, patrolling the facility and grounds, monitoring security cameras, enforcing parking regulations, issuing parking passes, tickets, lockers and keys, and processing payments/counting cash. Providing daily and pre-landing inspections of the heliport.
 Restraining combative patients, perform individual patient watches, assist in locating missing or wandering patients, calling codes during emergencies, and admits/discharges bodies from the morgue.
 Monitors suspicious activities, apprehending and detaining suspects, removing and cataloguing dangerous weapons, and escorting individuals from the property.
 Extensive and comprehensive report writing using a specific application on a cell phone.
 Candidates must be willing and able to work a 12-hour shift rotation. 
 Due to the hands-on nature of the role, extensive training will be provided to successful candidates which includes handcuff training and defensive tactics training.  Successful candidates will be required to pass a basic physical test.
 Indigenous candidates and those possessing a Saskatchewan Security Guard training certificate will be given preference.  Candidates without the certificate will be considered.  Must be 18 years of age or older.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Description du poste 
 Ce poste joue un rôle essentiel dans la sécurité et la protection de toutes les personnes qui accèdent à l’hôpital, notamment le personnel, les patients, les clients et les visiteurs. En tant qu’établissement multiculturel, le respect et le maintien d’un environnement sécuritaire et inclusif pour tous sont essentiels.
 Il s’agit d’un poste pratique qui exige notamment la capacité de menotter et de maîtriser des patients agités ou agressifs, ainsi que de désamorcer les situations violentes ou agressives lorsqu’elles surviennent.
 Les tâches comprennent, sans toutefois s’y limiter : 
 Assurer la sécurité générale de l’ensemble de l’établissement, notamment en verrouillant et déverrouillant les portes, en effectuant des rondes dans l’établissement et sur les terrains, en surveillant les caméras de sécurité et en faisant respecter les règlements relatifs au stationnement.
 Distribuer des permis de stationnement, des contraventions, des casiers et des clés, ainsi que traiter les paiements et effectuer le décompte des espèces.
 Effectuer les inspections quotidiennes et les inspections préalables à l’atterrissage de l’héliport.
 Maîtriser les patients agités ou agressifs, assurer la surveillance individuelle des patients et aider à retrouver les patients portés disparus ou errants.
 Appeler les codes d’urgence lors de situations critiques et assurer l’admission et la sortie des dépouilles de la morgue.
 Surveiller les activités suspectes, appréhender et retenir les personnes suspectées, retirer et inventorier les armes ou objets dangereux, et escorter les personnes hors de la propriété.
 Rédiger des rapports détaillés et complets à l’aide d’une application spécifique sur un téléphone cellulaire.
 Les candidats doivent être disposés et capables de travailler selon un horaire rotatif comprenant des quarts de 12 heures .
 En raison de la nature pratique du poste, une formation approfondie sera offerte aux candidats retenus. Celle-ci comprendra notamment une formation sur les techniques de menottage et les techniques de défense. Les candidats retenus devront également réussir un test physique de base.
 Les candidats autochtones ainsi que les personnes détenant un certificat de formation d’agent de sécurité de la Saskatchewan seront privilégiés. Les candidats ne possédant pas ce certificat seront également considérés.
 Les candidats doivent être âgés de 18 ans ou plus .

ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


ABOUT THE FINANCIAL SERVICES TEAM

 - Our financial services customers span systemically important banks, neobanks committed to building more delightful banking software (1 in 3 of the world's leading banks use Sierra!), insurers that provide protection for life’s most challenging moments, vertically integrated ecosystems like Rocket Companies, and more. The decisions we make impact millions of end customers and billions of dollars in economic activity.

 - Our financial services team partners closely with these organizations to set their AI strategies and build modern tools that carefully handle moments when a person’s private anxiety meets an institution’s procedural muscle - the instant before a family learns whether they are pre-approved for a mortgage; the claustrophobic half hour after someone notices a fraudulent charge; the frustrating experience of losing a card and needing to order a new one.

 - Sierra’s Financial Services team is transforming the customer experience and building technology that makes the industry more accessible, human, and affordable for everyone.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Be the primary partner to your Sales counterparts helping to win deals and grow customers

 - Go from first discovery to a tailored, working agent in days, not weeks, across prospects and existing customers

 - Work with every team involved in the decision: CX, IT, security, procurement, and executive sponsors

 - Own the end-to-end technical pre-sales process by scoping customer use cases, articulating business value, designing and demoing Sierra’s incredible platform, leading technical and architecture reviews, and serving as the trusted technical expert throughout the sales cycle

 - Mentor newer SEs and contribute reusable assets for your industry or team

 - Stay with the account after the sale, through the Agent Development handoff, launch, and expansion to new use cases

 - Go deep on your industry, the patterns, and winning motions to scale your work


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 4-6+ years experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering or customer-facing technical sales

 - Experience in leading the sales process with large Enterprise customers with deal sizes ranging $500-$1M

 - Past experience in demo building, and presenting, and working with customers or clients in the GTM function

 - Experience in relationship-building with prospects, including executives and technical leaders

 - Ability to connect a prospect’s specific business problems and Sierra’s solutions and explain them to both a technical and non-technical audience

 - Ability to leverage AI tools efficiently as a regular part of your technical sales motion — discovery prep, solution design, demo and prototype building, technical proposals. Importantly, you own the accuracy of anything you put in front of a customer, whether or not AI helped you build it

 - Experience growing accounts past initial sale

 - Bachelor's Degree or above; bonus if in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience


EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience translating code, technical logic and user requirements to product and engineering requirements

 - Selling a technical AI product


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

As our solutions mature, you will help turn what works into repeatable playbooks and deliverables that support external customers on their own change journeys.

 Change & Adoption Delivery: Lead the delivery of change management and adoption plans for Evinova's AI-enabled solutions across clinical development, translating the transformation strategy and roadmap into actionable workstream plans, turning points, and deliverables.

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $169 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.



About the team

 

The Data Science team at Wealthsimple consists of data scientists with diverse educational backgrounds such as physics, computer science, engineering and business. The Sales Data team is responsible for supporting the entire Commercial team through data modeling, pipelining, dashboarding, experimentation, analyses, and machine learning models. Our stakeholder teams are diverse, including Financial Planners & Advisors, Business Development Representatives, Revenue Operations and Commercial Systems. We build data solutions that directly optimize the sales process, improve lead scoring and routing, boost lifecycle marketing and drive revenue growth for Wealthsimple’s core metrics.

 

We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong foundational skills in both data engineering and applied data science. In this role, you will act as a generalist bridging the gap between data architecture and applied science. You will take ownership of stakeholder relationships while designing, building, and maintaining robust data models and pipelines to scale our Commercial operations.



In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

 - Design, build, and maintain accurate, reliable data pipelines and commercial data marts using modern tools like dbt and Airflow.

 - Balance technical execution roughly 50/50 between data engineering/pipelining and applied data science/analytics.

 - Optimize commercial operations by enhancing lead generation, lead routing, and sales efficiency using sparse or multi-modal data sources.

 - Develop, implement, and maintain metrics, dashboards, and predictive models that directly impact top-line business goals.

 - Manage direct relationships with business stakeholders across Sales Operations, Commercial Leadership, Revenue Operations, and Product.

 - Conduct exploratory analyses and design experiments (e.g., A/B testing) to test hypotheses and improve go-to-market strategies.

 - Collaborate closely with teammates to raise data quality standards, share knowledge, and improve core data architecture.
   
   

What you bring:

 - 2–4 years of experience in a Data Science, Decision Science, or Analytics Engineering role.
